description: This file contains repository functions for managing reviews and review results in a database, including creation, retrieval, and listing of reviews, with some functions scoped to user ownership.

methods.name: createReview({ userId, language, code, title, status = 'completed' })
methods.description: Creates a new review entry in the database, with optional userId for anonymous reviews.

methods.name: createReviewResult({ reviewId, summary, issues, suggestions, rawResult, model })
methods.description: Creates a review result entry linked to a review, enforcing a one-to-one relation.

methods.name: listReviewsByUser({ userId, limit, offset })
methods.description: Lists reviews for a specific user along with their associated results.

methods.name: getReviewByIdForUser({ reviewId, userId })
methods.description: Fetches a specific review and its result for a given user, ensuring ownership.

methods.name: listReviews({ limit, offset })
methods.description: Lists all reviews across users and anonymous submissions with their results.

methods.name: getReviewById({ reviewId })
methods.description: Fetches a review and its result by ID without ownership filtering.

ctags.name: createReview
ctags.pattern: /^async function createReview({ userId, language, code, title, status = 'completed' }) {$/

ctags.name: createReviewResult
ctags.pattern: /^async function createReviewResult({ reviewId, summary, issues, suggestions, rawResult, model }) /
ctags.signature: ({ reviewId, summary, issues, suggestions, rawResult, model })
